decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template draws directly on the firm's shop-hosting know-how, so the firm can easily read its uptake and keep it current, though templates are lightweight offers that can quietly disappear.
The responsive website template sits close to the firm's CMS expertise and costs little to maintain, but it got only a brief mention on the website, which suggests low strategic weight.
Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert support, so it fits existing knowledge and centralized service operations and should keep improving.

The version management tool builds on the firm's in-house software development and its aim of reducing recurring operational work, and its dedicated page signals commitment and a solid basis for learning from user feedback.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the firm's technical knowledge base and is legally demanding to maintain, but GDPR demand from agency customers and its dedicated page favour keeping it for now despite elevated risk.
